name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: A Central Sector scheme providing income support to eligible landholding farmer families, subject to the scheme guidelines and exclusion categories.

eligibility.age: No age rule is asserted in this prototype record; verify the current guidelines.
eligibility.income: Certain exclusion categories apply, including specified higher economic status categories; verify the current official exclusions.
eligibility.other: State and Union Territory administrations identify eligible farmer families. Landholding, family definition, registration, and eKYC requirements must be verified.

benefits: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal instalments, as described on the official portal.
Funds are transferred directly to beneficiary bank accounts subject to verification.
documents: Details needed for farmer registration and verification as specified by the official portal.
Bank account, identity, land, and eKYC requirements must be confirmed before applying.
authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
